# Polling

Descriptor flags and the kqueue filters a poller waits with.

<h2 id="f-getfl"><code>F_GETFL</code></h2>

```rux
pub const F_GETFL: int32 = 3;
```

`F_GETFL`: the [`fcntl`](/docs/api/macos/spawn#fcntl) command that reads a descriptor's status flags.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L11)

<h2 id="f-setfl"><code>F_SETFL</code></h2>

```rux
pub const F_SETFL: int32 = 4;
```

`F_SETFL`: the [`fcntl`](/docs/api/macos/spawn#fcntl) command that sets a descriptor's status flags.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L16)

<h2 id="o-nonblock"><code>O_NONBLOCK</code></h2>

```rux
pub const O_NONBLOCK: int32 = 0x4;
```

`O_NONBLOCK`: the status flag that makes a call fail with [`EAGAIN`](/docs/api/macos/errors#eagain) rather than wait.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L21)

<h2 id="evfilt-read"><code>EVFILT_READ</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EVFILT_READ: int16 = -1;
```

`EVFILT_READ`: the filter that reports a descriptor with something to read, or a connection to accept.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L26)

<h2 id="evfilt-write"><code>EVFILT_WRITE</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EVFILT_WRITE: int16 = -2;
```

`EVFILT_WRITE`: the filter that reports a descriptor a write would not wait on.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L31)

<h2 id="ev-add"><code>EV_ADD</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EV_ADD: uint16 = 0x1;
```

`EV_ADD`: add the change's filter, or update it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L36)

<h2 id="ev-delete"><code>EV_DELETE</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EV_DELETE: uint16 = 0x2;
```

`EV_DELETE`: remove the change's filter.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L41)

<h2 id="ev-receipt"><code>EV_RECEIPT</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EV_RECEIPT: uint16 = 0x40;
```

`EV_RECEIPT`: report each change as an event, with its outcome in `data`, rather than waiting.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L46)

<h2 id="ev-error"><code>EV_ERROR</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EV_ERROR: uint16 = 0x4000;
```

`EV_ERROR`: set on an event that reports a failed change, with the error number in `data`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L51)

<h2 id="ev-eof"><code>EV_EOF</code></h2>

```rux
pub const EV_EOF: uint16 = 0x8000;
```

`EV_EOF`: the peer has closed its side.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L56)

<h2 id="kevent"><code>Kevent</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Kevent {
    pub ident: uint64;
    pub filter: int16;
    pub flags: uint16;
    pub filterFlags: uint32;
    pub data: int64;
    pub userData: uint64;
}
```

One `struct kevent` as 64-bit macOS lays it out: a change to register or an event to report.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L60)

**Fields**

| Name          | Type     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ident`       | `uint64` | The descriptor.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `filter`      | `int16`  | [`EVFILT_READ`](/docs/api/macos/poll#evfilt-read) or [`EVFILT_WRITE`](/docs/api/macos/poll#evfilt-write).                                                                                                            |
| `flags`       | `uint16` | [`EV_ADD`](/docs/api/macos/poll#ev-add), [`EV_DELETE`](/docs/api/macos/poll#ev-delete) and the flags reported back, such as [`EV_EOF`](/docs/api/macos/poll#ev-eof) and [`EV_ERROR`](/docs/api/macos/poll#ev-error). |
| `filterFlags` | `uint32` | Filter-specific flags.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `data`        | `int64`  | Filter-specific data: bytes ready, or an error number.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `userData`    | `uint64` | The word the caller chose, reported back with every event.                                                                                                                                                           |

**Associated functions**

<h3 id="kevent-new"><code>Of</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Of(
    ident: uint64,
    filter: int16,
    flags: uint16,
    userData: uint64
) -> Kevent
```

A change or an empty event: `filter` on `ident` with `flags`, reporting `userData`.

| Name       | Type     | Description                                     |
| ---------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `ident`    | `uint64` | the descriptor                                  |
| `filter`   | `int16`  | the filter                                      |
| `flags`    | `uint16` | such as [`EV_ADD`](/docs/api/macos/poll#ev-add) |
| `userData` | `uint64` | the word to report                              |

**Returns**: the kevent

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L83)

<h2 id="fcntl-int"><code>FcntlInt</code></h2>

```rux
pub func FcntlInt(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    command: int32,
    argument: int64
) -> int64
```

Performs `command` on a descriptor with an integer argument.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/fcntl.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/fcntl.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L102)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type             | Description                                                                                    |
| ---------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`       | `FileDescriptor` | the descriptor                                                                                 |
| `command`  | `int32`          | such as [`F_GETFL`](/docs/api/macos/poll#f-getfl) or [`F_SETFL`](/docs/api/macos/poll#f-setfl) |
| `argument` | `int64`          | the command's argument, or zero                                                                |

**Returns**: the command's result, or a negative error number

<h2 id="kqueue"><code>Kqueue</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Kqueue() -> int64
```

Opens a kqueue.

<h2 id="kevent-call"><code>KeventCall</code></h2>

```rux
pub func KeventCall(
    queue: FileDescriptor,
    changes: *Kevent,
    changeCount: int32,
    events: *var Kevent,
    eventCount: int32,
    timeout: *Timespec
) -> int64
```

Applies `changeCount` changes, then waits until an event is ready or `timeout` passes, filling `events`.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/kevent.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/kevent.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Poll.rux#L124)

**Parameters**

| Name          | Type             | Description                                   |
| ------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `queue`       | `FileDescriptor` | the kqueue                                    |
| `changes`     | `*Kevent`        | the changes to apply, or null                 |
| `changeCount` | `int32`          | how many changes there are                    |
| `events`      | `*var Kevent`    | room for `eventCount` events, or null         |
| `eventCount`  | `int32`          | how many events fit                           |
| `timeout`     | `*Timespec`      | how long to wait, or null to wait without end |

**Returns**: how many events were filled, or a negative error number
